config firewall address
edit "Prefix-example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-example.com-IP-1"
set subnet 93.184.216.34 255.255.255.255
set comment "Resolved from example.com | ip=93.184.216.34 | resolved_at=2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
next

edit "Prefix-example.com-IP-2"
set subnet 93.184.216.35 255.255.255.255
set comment "Resolved from example.com | ip=93.184.216.35 | resolved_at=2026-01-02 03:04:05Z"
next

edit "Prefix-fail.example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "fail.example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-empty.example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "empty.example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-*.wild.example.com"
set type fqdn
set fqdn "*.wild.example.com"
next

edit "Prefix-10.9.9.9"
set subnet 10.9.9.9 255.255.255.255
next

end

config firewall addrgrp
edit "Prefix-Generated Objects"
set member "Prefix-example.com" "Prefix-example.com-IP-1" "Prefix-example.com-IP-2" "Prefix-fail.example.com" "Prefix-empty.example.com" "Prefix-*.wild.example.com" "Prefix-10.9.9.9"
next

end
